sections.heading: IT integration for *energy and mining*
sections.body:
Our focus is Mining and Oil & Gas: maintenance, material flows, terminal processes and enterprise applications. Linkfields combines integration, platforms and analytics to bring operational information into reviewable workflows, secure by design.

Business-system integration and decision-support analytics are distinct from process control and safety-critical engineering. Confirm data access, operational ownership and the IT/OT boundary before extending any scope.

Explore [Mining workflows](#mining) or [Oil & Gas workflows](#oil-gas).

sections.heading: What we deliver for mining
sections.description: Bring equipment, maintenance and material information into connected workflows so teams can identify exceptions and plan action.

items.title: Asset health and maintenance planning
items.description: Connect equipment history and maintenance records so teams can investigate condition changes and plan interventions.
items.bullets:
Prerequisite – validate usable history and model performance.
Boundary – recommendations support maintenance owners, not automated control or safety decisions.
Measure to agree – Maintenance schedule adherence and unplanned downtime over an agreed period.

items.title: Materials, inventory and logistics
items.description: Connect extraction-to-delivery material records, inventory and business logistics applications to expose reconciliation exceptions.
items.bullets:
Control – materials teams review discrepancies and approve adjustments.
Output – reconciled material views and inventory exception workflows.
Measure to agree – Inventory variance, reconciliation effort and material-data completeness.

items.title: Operational reporting and exception review
items.description: Bring approved asset and process data into dashboards with explicit freshness, lineage and role-based access.
items.bullets:
Control – supervisors investigate exceptions and coordinate action.
Output – metric definitions, reporting views and an escalation route.
Measure to agree – Reporting freshness, completeness and time to investigate exceptions.

sections.heading: What we deliver for Oil & Gas
sections.description: Connect midstream and downstream terminal processes, ERP and fuel retail applications to give teams a clearer view of inventory, exceptions and performance.

items.title: Terminal workflow integration
items.description: Connect terminal business records and operational-system interfaces for midstream and downstream exception handling.
items.bullets:
Control – terminal staff authorise changes within agreed access boundaries.
Output – interface map, transaction reconciliation and an exception queue.
Measure to agree – Transaction completeness and exception resolution time.

items.title: ERP and operational integration
items.description: Connect finance, procurement, inventory and asset-related business records through agreed ERP and application interfaces.
items.bullets:
Control – process owners approve reconciliations and release gates.
Output – data mapping, regression pack and migration acceptance evidence.
Measure to agree – Reconciliation exceptions and application release defects.

items.title: Fuel commerce and retail applications
items.description: Connect order, site and commercial application data with enterprise processes for fuel retail and commercial operations.
items.bullets:
Control – commercial teams review order and service exceptions.
Output – composable application/API flows and agreed regression tests.
Measure to agree – Order hand-off completeness and exception handling effort.

items.title: Asset and operational analytics
items.description: Combine approved asset history, inventory and operational records to support reporting, simulation and planning.
items.bullets:
Prerequisite – validate source data, freshness and prediction fit.
Boundary – analysts review outputs; models do not operate process controls.
Measure to agree – Forecast evaluation, reporting completeness and planning rework.

sections.heading: Resource-operations software and accelerators
sections.description: Select software and accelerators to fit your site data, interfaces and business requirements. Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without services. Accelerators are reusable delivery IP configured and tailored to scope.

items.title: Linkworks
items.description: Composable workflow applications and REST APIs for business-system integration. Configure process rules and tailor interfaces to the systems in scope.

items.title: Digital Twin Suite
items.description: Equipment failure prediction, forecasting simulation, inventory optimisation and monitoring IP. Set data freshness and validation requirements for each use case.

items.title: Predictive Analytics Suite
items.description: Forecasting IP for planning on usable historical data. Agree evaluation criteria, human review and the operational limits of any model.

items.title: Delivery accelerators
items.description: Migration, integration and regression packs for enterprise application change. Pair release evidence with testoriumz software quality engineering where appropriate.

sections.heading: Move from discovery to governed delivery
sections.description: Which asset or material workflow needs better visibility? Start with the business process, source data and system interfaces.

items.title: Map systems and decision rights
items.description: An example engagement maps asset sources, ERP or terminal business interfaces and the people who act on outputs. Separate advisory analytics from process control.
items.bullets:
Artefacts – data-flow architecture and responsibility matrix
Decisions – approved access, data freshness and change authority

items.title: Validate before operational use
items.description: Review history and model fit, test interfaces and agree a controlled release. Capture exception handling, security controls and operational acceptance.
items.bullets:
Artefacts – validation record, regression evidence and release plan
Measures – baseline, evaluation period and acceptance thresholds

items.title: Scope an appropriate engagement
items.description: Agree discovery and delivery scope first. Consider Fixed Price or Time & Materials for change, a Dedicated Team for sustained work, or Managed Service for enterprise applications.

sections.note: Name the process and existing systems without sharing sensitive site or control-system details. We can agree an NDA before sharing confidential information.
